correctness.rationale: The full chain identification follows from all interlevel arrows and deletion closure. The nonregular q-boundary has d^N=0 by vanishing root-of-unity N-factorial. Equivariant augmentation splitting preserves fixed-W subsets; conjugating optional-variable basis vectors by an explicit product of root powers yields canonical Boolean blocks independent of their positions. Kernels/images and traces then give the claimed representations for every size, r,N,q. The N=3 three-level small blocks are computed by exact ranks (explicit determinant and nonzero composites). A standalone finite-field checker independently matches 41 complete direct and universal homology vectors for roots of orders 2-5; finite checks are consistency evidence, not the general proof.

value.rationale: The exact representation character depends only on r,N,q and permutation fixed-point data via canonical matrices independent of arbitrary large layer sizes. The proof reveals unexpected symmetry of Mayer invariants under reordering directed layer data and identifies every representation summand, not just their ranks. Its complete cubic-root, three-layer modules show nonclassical homology classes while classical reduced homology of the corresponding simplicial join is concentrated in top degree, establishing a substantive family-wide benchmark for a 2026 invariant.
